source.title: Description of a morphologically distinct and phylogenetically divergent new species of the leopard gecko in the genus Eublepharis Gray, 1827 (Reptilia, Eublepharidae) from India

where: Systematics > Eublepharis jhuma sp. nov. > Table 4, row OD (orbital diameter), column headed 'ZSI-R-29431 (holotype)'
note: orbital diameter, not eye diameter: Methods define 'orbital diameter (OD (orbital diameter): greatest diameter of orbit)', the greatest diameter of the orbit, so this is sensory_anatomy and not eye_diameter_mm. The Table 4 caption prints no unit; the Methods print 'to the nearest 0.1 mm', and mm is read from that sentence, not from a table unit label. Sex conflict printed in the paper: the Type materials section and Table 4 list paratype ZSI-R-29345 as female, while the Variation section calls it '(male)'; sex here follows Table 4 and Type materials. Different value from main: desk-d353 filed only the holotype ratio OD/HL 0.24 (units ratio); no millimetre OD is on main (grep of origin/main docs for the DOI: only desk-d353 lines). Reptile Database species page opened from a search result: 'Eublepharis jhuma Mohapatra, Ray, Das, Satrusallya, Jena, Bhupathi, Das & Mahapatra, 2026', Eublepharidae, holotype ZSI-R-29431, paratypes ZSI-R-29344 and ZSI-R-29345; no explicit 'valid'. Licence sentence on the copy read (reader's wording, clause cut): 'distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0)'; the auditor should confirm the whole sentence. Heading path from the reader: Systematics > 'Eublepharis jhumasp. nov.' (sic) > Type materials / Diagnosis / Comparison > Description of the holotype.
